verdict.rationale: The integrations directory shows third-party content rendered inside Notion pages, such as Tableau dashboards, Mixpanel charts, and Canva and Sketch designs. That suggests external views can be surfaced in-product. However, the developer docs cover only data-level access (REST API, webhooks, connections) and document no UI extension SDK for building custom native views or widgets. Missing for 10: a documented UI or extension framework for custom views and dashboard widgets, native styling or component guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration that custom widgets feel native.
